### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://ec.europa.eu/commission/presscorner/api/files/attachment/875671/Factsheet HERA Invest.pdf
HERA Invest targets innovative companies (particularly SMEs) in clinical trials.
HERA Invest targets innovative SMEs and midcaps with an innovative platform technology.
Companies developing medical countermeasures which tackle one of the following health threats: pandemic or epidemic pathogens; chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear (CBRN) threats; antimicrobial resistance.
promote advanced research and development of medical countermeasures and related technologies
Companies must have already raised equity from professional investors, have a sustainable business model and business plan, and have a solid corporate governance in place.
Through non-dilutive venture debt, into promising projects, to leverage further private investment.
The EIB will typically invest between €15 and 30 million per project.
On behalf of HERA, EIB can invest up to 50% of project costs.
Get in touch to know more! HERA-INVEST@ec.europa.eu
